My full name is Francesco Romano Monda. My surname is dual and please do not get confused about it.
When I was younger, I used to play basketball. However, I lost interest in it as I began grappling with the harsh socio-economic reality of adulthood.
I am vegan and eggplant is my favourite vegetable.
One of my preferred song is [The Sound of Silence](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NAEppFUWLfc) by Simon & Garfunkel.
The older I get, the harder it is for me to open up about myself.
I will try to describe what has been happening to me by echoing Arthur Schopenauer: "Life swings like a pendulum backward and forward between pain and boredom".
